headline: Fisherman's Row Erupts Anew; Weathered Expanse Falls Quiet
war_summary: Fisherman's Row, silent at our last filing, has burst back into motion: thirty-two base events in a day, fresh fighting within the past two hours, and one post now lying in no-man's-land, leaving the Colonials six of nine bases to the Wardens' two. The Weathered Expanse tells the opposite tale — six Warden holds against three Colonial, but not an event in the last two hours after a day that logged fifty-one. Mooring County, ten Warden posts to two, shows no let-up, with hourly casualty figures climbing anew. Callahan's Passage keeps its eight-two Warden line and its dreadful ledger, some twenty-two thousand casualties added in a day, though its guns too have gone quiet of late. Stlican Shelf's four-five split endures; Palantine Berm's flurry at Leiri Hermanni has ebbed, and the Nevish Line's great exchange slackens further, while Marban Hollow's casualty rate quickens. It is day 398 of this war; thirty-four victory towns will settle it, and no victor is yet named.
